integrity: The proof uses a 2K2-free induced-path bound and explicit induced P3/P4 witnesses through every selected edge and third selected vertex. Counting follows from an index-cut bijection. The verifier independently enumerates paths and subsets.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the canonical half graph, not arbitrary chain graphs with twin multiplicities.
The scalar maximum is close to the published triangle-free upper bound and is not the originality basis.
Finite verification through n=8 is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed chain-graph treatment may exist.
title: All monophonic position sets of half graphs
